title: Blockywars 16x
description: Simplistic and FPS-boosting, designed for smooth BedWars gameplay and PvP in general.
body:
BlockyWars 16x is a clean and simplistic 16x PvP resource pack** designed for smooth gameplay in BedWars and all other PvP game modes. It features FPS-friendly textures, a minimal color palette, and optimized visuals that improve clarity without changing Minecraft's classic style.

The pack includes short, clean swords, simple blocks, high-contrast wool, and easy-to-read textures, making bridging, block placement, and PvP feel more consistent. Every texture is designed to reduce visual clutter while maintaining a polished and modern look.

Whether you're grinding BedWars, SkyWars, Duels, or any competitive PvP mode, BlockyWars 16x delivers a lightweight, performance-focused experience with excellent visibility and smooth gameplay.
